TurnNameEffect
Start of Turn Implements one (two after 50%) of the following Taboos at beginning of turn.
Harbinger of Resistance: Another Force Another Force (using Another Force violates the Taboo)
  • Punishment: End of Turn Divine Wrath: Another Force: Disables AF
  • Reward: End of Turn Blessing: Another Force: Increases AF gauge by ~25%
Harbinger of Resistance: Healing Healing (Healing your frontline violates the Taboo)
  • Punishment: End of Turn Divine Wrath: Healing: Decreases max HP
  • Reward: End of Turn Blessing: Healing: Increases max HP
Harbinger of Resistance: Elements Element (Attacking with certain elements violates the Taboo)
  • Punishment: End of Turn Divine Wrath: Elements: Physical + Magical attack debuff
  • Reward: End of Turn Blessing: Elements: Physical + Magical attack buff
Harbinger of Resistance: Refresh Refresh (Inflict poison , removing it violates the taboo)
  • Punishment: End of Turn Divine Wrath: Refresh: Causes Confusion
  • Reward: End of Turn Blessing: Refresh: Grants Regen
Harbinger of Resistance: Zone Zone (clears current zone so Placing a Zone violates the Taboo)
  • Punishment: End of Turn Divine Wrath: Zone: Sets Chaos Stance
  • Reward: End of Turn Blessing: Zone: Sets Sea of Stars Stance
